A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BBVI convergence study, with matching main sections and Appendices A–B. Their complete text and mathematical displays support comparison; the added checklist and reorganized proofs do not create material gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports theoretical bounds and proofs, including throughout its appendices. Empirical observations are attributed to prior studies; no original experimental, simulation, or data-analysis results are reported.

after.justification: v2 remains theoretical throughout the main text and appendices. Its new checklist also explicitly states that the paper contains no experiments.

M1.justification: Both analyze the same mean-field location-scale family, reparametrization gradient, linear parametrization, proximal update, and two-stage step-size schedule. The revisions concern their explanation and analysis.

E1.justification: Neither version evaluates datasets or empirical tasks. Gaussian and Student-t families remain theoretical examples, rather than added evaluation scenarios.

E2.justification: Neither version experimentally evaluates comparison methods. Full-rank BBVI, Wasserstein VI, and CAVI appear as theoretical comparisons; the additional citations do not introduce evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Neither version specifies an empirical evaluation protocol. The retained theoretical optimization schedule and parameter-distance accuracy criterion do not constitute changed experimental settings.

E4.justification: Neither version contains ablations, empirical robustness tests, sensitivity experiments, or case studies. The expanded appendix arguments are mathematical proofs.

E5.justification: Neither version reports empirical runs, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Revisions to theoretical gradient-variance assumptions belong under T1.

E6.justification: There are no empirical result entries in either version. The principal convergence rates and displayed Gaussian and Student-t complexity bounds are retained.

T1.justification: v2 explicitly permits zero variance in Assumption 2.8, restricts Proposition 4.2 to positive μ and L, and qualifies its spectral bounds as almost sure. It corrects the rounded switching-time equality to an inequality in B.1.1 and fixes several mathematical expressions. Lemma B.6 formalizes invariance in the existing construction, while Lemma A.4 largely repackages v1 Eq. (16); the principal bounds remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract changes an 'objective' ε-close claim to a 'solution' ε-close claim and explicitly presents O(log d) as the dimension dependence. This corrects the headline's scope toward the retained parameter-distance guarantee. The central convergence and unimprovability contributions remain the same.

C2.justification: Remark 4.3 adds the conservative-vector-field explanation for the already acknowledged Hessian-realizability limitation. Section 2.1 qualifies support transformations when discrete variables are involved, and Section 5.2 adds the gap in statistical-accuracy understanding for families between mean-field and full-rank.

D1.justification: The algorithmic update and step-size information are already present in v1. v2 adds no implementation settings, hardware or runtime information, or code/data access instructions; its experimental reproducibility checklist answers are not applicable.

R1.justification: Section 5.2 adds control-variate references, including Boustati et al. and Geffner and Domke, and statistical-accuracy literature including Katsevich and Rigollet and Margossian and Saul. This modestly broadens the positioning. Publication updates for retained works such as Jiang et al. and Bhattacharya et al. are not new cited studies.

P1.justification: v2 edits the abstract, introduction, and explanations; adds an Overview subsection to Section 4; and reorganizes B.3.4. It also adds funding disclosures and a NeurIPS checklist. Most prose and the overall scientific narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Neither PDF contains figures or result tables. v2 reformats mathematical displays, separates the proximal definition from the update, expands proof displays, and adds checklist pages and a conference footer while retaining the basic layout.

improvement.justification: v2 improves precision through the corrected abstract accuracy claim, the switching-time inequality correction in B.1.1, and clearer explanation of the existing lower-bound construction. Added applicability qualifications and statistical-accuracy references provide useful context. These are limited gains: the central rates and the unresolved Hessian-realizability limitation remain unchanged.
